library.name: crlibm
library.source: github.com/taschini/crlibm, a mirror of the INRIA Forge project (anonymous access to gitlab.inria.fr/crlibm requires authentication)
library.built: WSL Ubuntu, autotools, gcc 15.2, --enable-sse2, x86-64 Linux, the non-double-extended configuration

reference.primary: MPFR 4.2.2 through gmpy2 2.3.1, Ziv loop with directed-rounding brackets
validated_against: exact Fraction/CPython oracle for to_double(): 0 mismatches in 5999 trials incl. 72 overflow-boundary cases
crlibm's own tests/*.testdata, generated independently by the authors with MPFR: 0 disagreements on all decided points (~48,000)
mpmath 1.4.1 at 400 digits, used for the two defect verifications
glibc libm in the four hardware rounding modes, used to confirm the IEEE overflow convention

documented_claims.universe: accuracy statements in the shipped manual (docs/latex/*.tex) about public crlibm entry points

m1_crlibm_vs_own_vectors.note: all 9 are NaN bit patterns (sign or payload); tests/blind_test.c accepts any NaN where the vector expects NaN

sinh.claim: 0_getting-started.tex:149, worst cases complete = correctly rounded on the whole floating-point input range
sinh.measured: sinh_rd and sinh_rz return +inf at x = 0x408633ce8fb9f87e; IEEE requires the largest finite double. Mirrored at x = -0x408633ce8fb9f87e for sinh_ru and sinh_rz
sinh.verdict: real defect, documented claim shown false
sinh.mechanism: csh_fast.c guards the overflow shortcut with x > max_input_csh (lines 575, 577, 619, 671) while cosh uses x >= max_input_csh (lines 224, 278); max_input_csh is byte-for-byte the failing input (csh_fast.h:16)
sinh.control: cosh at the same input and modes is correct, and cosh.testdata covers that input while sinh.testdata has no entry there

atanpi.measured: atanpi_rd and atanpi_rz return 0.5 where the correctly rounded value is 0.5 - 2^-54, for |x| above about 3e16 up to 1e300; negative mirror fails atanpi_ru and atanpi_rz
atanpi.verdict: real defect, but OUTSIDE the documented domain, so not a false claim; the manual states correct rounding is proven only on [9.4e-8, 0.098]
